title: N-0085 U1: listing polling on under the supervisor, restock seen again, dead-link back-off, per-site 403/429 pause, run time limit
acceptance_criteria: The supervisor's worker environment sets CIP_LISTING_CAPTURE_SCHEDULE and CIP_LISTING_LIVE_FETCH; status shows both present
A beat run records new Takealot and Evetech observations on cip
An out_of_stock listing seen in stock returns to active (restocked); out_of_stock listings keep being polled
consecutive failures drive the dead-link back-off; a 403/429 pauses only that site (1 h doubling to 24 h) and is recorded
Each poll run takes the oldest-due listings first, mixes retailers and stops at 10 minutes
Market ledger copy 'Checked on a schedule' is true, or changed to what is true
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
